purpose: Formalize, as governed official_unavailable evidence-state closures, the per-constituency Form 34B turnout blockers that six parallel P23 source-verification tranches (PRs #135-#140) independently documented but left recorded only in their merged pull-request descriptions rather than as persisted repository data. Each decision below reflects a genuine, already-documented source-document defect (a registered-voters denominator conflict, an internal candidate-arithmetic inconsistency, a structural scan defect, or an IEBC portal access failure) rather than a fabricated, estimated, or forced value. decisions.reason: Independently source-verified during the P23 Form 34B turnout extraction programme, documented in PR #137 (https://github.com/dansamuka/kenya-data-atlas/pull/137): the printed Form 34B TOTAL-row registered-voters figure for Laikipia East is 96,535, exceeding the governed canonical P23 constituency registered-voters denominator (96,395) by exactly 140 -- a gap that exactly matches the Nanyuki Prison polling station's own registered-voter count. This is a genuine denominator conflict between the printed source document and the Atlas's canonical registered-voters series, not a transcription error: the extra voters are real, registered, and printed on the official form, but they are enrolled at a special-facility polling station that the canonical ward-derived denominator excludes. Per the P23 Form 34B extraction contract (data/p23/form34b-extraction-contract.json), the registered_voters field carries mismatch_treatment=unresolved and may not be silently corrected or force-reconciled to promote a turnout figure. Promoting a locally-computed turnout value against the canonical denominator would additionally require this constituency's total-valid-votes and rejected-ballots figures broken out consistently with that adjustment; those figures were not preserved in the session record that produced this finding and were not independently re-derived (by fresh PDF download and re-read) in this closure pass, so no computation is attempted here.
